messages.label: Step 0 (listening_for_discover) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_first_request. Cond: dhcpv4.is_dhcp_discover() and dhcpv4.chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dhcpv4.dut_iface_mac)
Step 1 (listening_for_first_request) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_arp_probe. Cond: dhcpv4.is_dhcp_request() and dhcpv4.chaddr_matches_dut_mac(expected.dhcpv4.dut_iface_mac)
Step 2 (listening_for_arp_probe) progress trigger — advances to listening_for_arp_announce. Cond: arp.is_dhcp_arp_probe(expected.dhcpv4.offered_ip_be)
Step 3 (listening_for_arp_announce) pass trigger — transitions to pass. Cond: arp.is_dhcp_arp_announce(expected.dhcpv4.offered_ip_be)
